name: Nozdormu
guide_text: Turn 1 if you have a 2 cost spell in your first shop, buy it and then roll and you'll likely roll into a 1 cost spell that you can then buy.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up on turn 5-6. Then, the wisdomball rolls will determine your game.
